enum.statDisclosure.ONS「Estimates of the: ONS "Estimates of the population for the UK, England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland", mid-2025 edition (published 2026-10-01): MYE4 total population, MYE5 population density and MYE6 median age, 15 years from mid-2011 to mid-2025, reference date 30 June of each year. England and Wales are ONS estimates, Scotland comes from NRS (rounded to the nearest 10) and Northern Ireland from NISRA; the three use different methods and sources, so compare across nations with caution. Population is the usually resident population (including international migrants staying one year or more; students counted at term-time address). Local authority districts follow April 2024 boundaries (LAD May 2024 codes), and earlier years have been re-based to these boundaries.
enum.statDisclosure.英格蘭與威爾斯：ONS 2021 Rur: England and Wales: ONS 2021 Rural Urban Classification (RUC21) supplementary Table 1E (LAD24), the official share of population living in rural OAs and the share living in OAs far from a major town (Census 2021 population, OA units; major town = built-up area with population ≥75,000; far = more than 30 minutes by car). Scotland: Scottish Government Urban Rural Classification 2022 (SGUR) combined with NRS Census 2022 table CA6FOLD, population share by the 6-fold classification for each council area; this dataset adds the two classes officially defined as rural (Accessible rural + Remote rural, settlements under 3,000 people) into a rural share. The two definitions differ (England and Wales use OAs and a 10,000-person built-up area threshold, Scotland a 3,000-person settlement threshold) and are not directly comparable. Northern Ireland: NISRA publishes settlements only, with no official rural population share at LGD level, so it is not covered and not aggregated by us. Class labels are in the notes.
enum.statDisclosure.英格蘭 2025 年多重剝奪指數（IoD: Official local authority summaries of the English Indices of Deprivation 2025 (IoD2025, MHCLG official statistics, published 2025, single edition) for lower-tier local authority districts (LAD 2024 codes). Taken from the IMD sheet of File 10 "Local Authority District Summaries (lower-tier) v2", two indicators: the average IMD score of all LSOAs in the district (higher = more deprived), and the share of the district's LSOAs in the most deprived 10% in England (source is a 0–1 decimal, converted to a 0–100 percentage; original values to four decimals). All 296 English LADs have values. England only: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland each have their own index with different methods and years, so they cannot be compared.
enum.statDisclosure.威爾斯 2025 年多重剝奪指數（WIM: Official summary of the Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation 2025 (WIMD 2025, Welsh Government accredited official statistics, updated 2026-02-06) for the 22 local authorities (LAD, W06): the share of each LA's LSOAs in the most deprived 10% (ranks 1–191) and 20% (ranks 1–382) of Wales's 1,917 LSOAs. Taken directly from the overall WIMD index percentage columns of StatsWales "WIMD 2025 local authority deprivation profiles", and independently recomputed from the LSOA rank table (rank ≤191 / ≤382, counted by each LSOA's LA, denominator = total LSOAs in that LA); all 22 LAs match exactly. Wales only; methods differ from England, Scotland and Northern Ireland, so they cannot be compared.
enum.statDisclosure.蘇格蘭 SIMD 2020v2（2020: Shares for Scotland's 32 council areas (S12) from SIMD 2020v2 (published January 2020 and revised in April that year for a DWP income data error; still the latest official edition as of 2026-10, there is no SIMD 2026): the share of each council area's 2011 data zones in the most deprived 10% (ranks 1–697) and 20% (ranks 1–1395) of Scotland's 6,976, denominator = total data zones in the council area. Thresholds follow the official rank-to-quintile/decile table. The 20% version was checked area by area against the official local share calculation table (2020v2) and matches. The source file has council area names only, no codes, so names were matched to current S12 codes. Scotland only; not comparable with other nations.
enum.statDisclosure.北愛爾蘭 NIMDM 2017（NISR: Shares for Northern Ireland's 11 local government districts (LGD2014, N09) from NIMDM 2017 (NISRA, published 2017-11-23, still the latest official edition): the share of each LGD's SOAs in the most deprived 10% (MDM ranks 1–89) and 20% (1–178) of Northern Ireland's 890 SOAs, denominator = number of SOAs in the LGD. The official LGD summaries (DeprivationLGD.pdf, LGD2014 tables) list only the most deprived SOAs and indicator values, not this share, so it was aggregated by us from NISRA's official SOA results file by rank, and the LGD codes and ranks of all 890 SOAs were checked one by one against the OpenDataNI SOA table (which includes LGD2014code). Northern Ireland only; NISRA states explicitly that the nations' indices cannot be compared.
enum.statDisclosure.HM Land Registry 彙整的: UK House Price Index local authority data compiled by HM Land Registry, from Average-prices-2026-08.csv (published 2026-10-21). Average prices are derived from a mix-adjusted (hedonic regression) house price index; England and Wales use HM Land Registry registered sales, Scotland uses Registers of Scotland, and Northern Ireland uses Land and Property Services / HMRC stamp duty data. This table takes the same month (August) each year, 11 periods (2016-08 to 2026-08), covering 361 LADs across the four nations (Northern Ireland 11 LGDs, Scotland 32 councils). Annual change is the source's 12-month percentage change. The Isles of Scilly are merged into Cornwall in the UK HPI and have no separate series, so they are marked missing.
enum.statDisclosure.英國國家統計局 ONS 的 Price: ONS Price Index of Private Rents, UK: monthly price statistics (2026-10-21 edition, Table 1). Built from administrative data (rental records) covering new and existing tenancies; indicators are average rent per area (Rental price, £ per month, rounded to whole pounds) and annual change (%). This table takes the same month (September) each year, 11 periods (2016-09 to 2026-09; PIPR starts 2015-01, annual change is available from 2016-01). Only England and Wales have LAD-level data (England 294, Wales 22); Scotland is published only at Broad Rental Market Area level (S33 codes) and Northern Ireland only at BRMA and national level, neither of which is LAD, so they are not included.
enum.statDisclosure.Defra「Structure of t: Local authority table of Defra "Structure of the agricultural industry in England and the UK at June" (structure-england-june-local-authority-16apr26.ods, 2025 sheet, updated 2026-04-16): land use areas estimated from the survey of commercial holdings in England, allocated by holding to 296 LADs (LAD May 2026 codes). This dataset takes the share of total farmed area under cereals, other arable crops (excluding cereals) and grassland, plus fruit and vegetable area (hectares). "#" marks values suppressed for fewer than 5 holdings (including secondary suppression); these are shown as suppressed, not filled with 0. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are not covered.
